## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] No prices, currency, sales or stock info added
- [ ] Specs come from the manufacturer's page, nothing guessed
- [ ] New photo hosts are added to `img-src` in `_headers`

- [ ] No secrets or personal data committed
